svg.title: SmartShop database ERD
svg.desc: Vector entity relationship diagram generated from the actual SQLite schema. Each panel corresponds to one printable A3 landscape PDF page.

g.text: 19 actual SQLite entities / 22 declared foreign keys. Pages 2-3: profiles, discussions, collections and settings.
Optional user_id links a login profile.
opening_due is prior debt, not sales revenue.
customer_id is optional for walk-in sales.
Unit price and unit cost are snapshots.
Image asset relationship continues on p2.
Expense date is separate from timestamp.
it is not a declared SQL foreign key.
Gross profit = sales revenue - sale-time goods cost.
Net profit = gross profit - dated expenses.
Opening dues and later customer receipts continue on p3.
No fabricated FK is drawn for stock movement references, the shop singleton or independent expense records.
PK Primary key FK Declared foreign key U Unique ? Nullable
Cardinality: | = one; circle = optional; crow foot = many. Solid connectors show declared SQL foreign keys.
Firebase verifies contacts. Profiles and ledger contacts are linked optionally; photo bytes use local or remote storage.
File bytes live on the selected provider.
JWT access lasts one day; refresh is revocable.
Shared discussion, visible to all visitors.
Only an owner can grant or revoke staff access.
Every API call resolves the current database role.
Explicit logout revokes the access/refresh session.
Refresh secrets and account passwords are never shown.
One user can have many sessions, reviews, comments and reactions; UNIQUE constraints prevent duplicate review/reaction votes.
PK Primary key FK Declared foreign key U Unique ? Nullable
Cardinality: | = one; circle = optional; crow foot = many. Solid connectors show declared SQL foreign keys.
Customer collections, stock alerts and shop settings
Collections reduce existing debt without creating sales. Reference stubs repeat parent keys from earlier pages; they are not extra entities.
A collection reduces existing customer dues.
Methods: cash / bkash / nagad / bank / other.
Read snapshot is specific to this user.
Payments settle opening debt first, then oldest invoices.
opening_amount is part of the receipt amount.
sales.paid remains the original checkout snapshot.
Collections increase cash received, not sales or profit.
All connectors on this page are declared SQL foreign keys. Reference stubs do not increase the unique entity count.
